self_assessment: Both Image structs gained a Digest string field tagged json:"digest" (config.Image and models.Image), and config.Image gained GetFullName(), returning Name@Digest when a digest is set and Name:Tag otherwise. IsValidImage now returns the three exact messages required: 'Invalid arguments : no image name' for an empty name, 'Invalid arguments : no image tag and digest' when neither is set, and 'Invalid arguments : you can either set image tag or digest' when both are. scan/base.go propagates ServerInfo.Image.Digest into models.Image, scan/container.go builds its scan domain from c.Image.GetFullName() instead of concatenating name and tag, and detectImageOSesOnServer now names each per-image server '<index>@<originalServerName>' with no tag or digest, assigning the iterated image straight to copied.Image. Report naming composes the full reference followed by @<serverName>, choosing the name@digest form when a digest is present and never concatenating both; I built that inline from models.Image rather than adding a second GetFullName, since the task states GetFullName is introduced only on config.Image. Verified: go build ./... clean, ./config ./scan ./report tests pass, and a scratch test covered GetFullName for the tag, digest and empty-tag cases plus all five IsValidImage outcomes with their exact error strings. ./models fails to build its tests both before and after my change - a modern go vet rejects a pre-existing int-to-string conversion in models/library.go.
